{{Quote|For a slave, Orvax is the living hell of the galaxy. There is no worse place that I know of.|[[Mezgraf]]|<ref name="DT 2" />}}
The '''slave market''' was a large [[City/Legends|city]]-like settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orvax IV]] where [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individuals from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were bought and sold. Those captured were kept in the lower levels until being brought up for sale.<ref name="DT 3">[[Dark Times 3|''Dark Times'' 3]]</ref> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The date of [[Dark Times 3|''Dark Times'' 3]] is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were taken to the markets on Orvax IV to be sold for profit, since they were primarily [[Gender/Legends|women]] and [[Youngling/Legends|children]] and could not be used in the Imperial workforce.<ref name="DT 2" />

The slave markets were inhabited by a number of different [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], [[T'surr (species)|T'surr]], [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrians]], and others. Some of these species utilized a [[Unidentified Orvax IV quadruped|quadrupedal creature]] as a beast of burden and mode of transportation.<ref name="DT 3" />
